title: Roget's Thesaurus
summary: The University of Chicago hosts an online version of Roget's Thesaurus, a classic reference work originally compiled by Peter Mark Roget in 1805. Unlike a standard dictionary, it organizes words by concepts and ideas rather than alphabetically, allowing users to browse related terms across categories.
problem_solved: Provides quick access to synonyms, antonyms, and conceptually related words for writers, students, and anyone seeking the right vocabulary.
why_valuable: Roget's unique conceptual organization by ideas rather than letters offers a creative alternative to alphabetical thesauruses, helping users explore language connections they might not discover otherwise.
